name: Encina de San Silvestre (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Encina de San Silvestre (a holm oak, a crozier and keys on blue and green).
history: The municipal flag of Encina de San Silvestre was approved on 27 March 2002, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 10 May 2002; it is rectangular and tricolour, with the municipal arms at the heart of the flag.
